offense.name: Low Pass
offense.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, max 2 spaces; or to one sharing its space, and the passer moves forward 1. Ball speed +1.

offense.name: Pinpoint
offense.effect:
Successful gambit: ball to any teammate up to 3 spaces away. Ball speed +3. 
Failed gambit: after stealing, the defender may Low Pass unopposed.

offense.name: Dribble
offense.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Manipulate ball speed (up to oSkill).

offense.name: Burst
offense.effect:
Successful gambit: player and ball move up to 4 spaces, exhausting 1 per space. Ball speed goes to 12. 
Failed gambit: lose possession; ball speed does not reset, and the defender adjusts it up to dSkill.

offense.name: High Pass
offense.effect: Ball moves forward 2-3 spaces. 2: received, and may set up for scoring. 3+: receiver must win a skill test to keep it, adding ball speed.

offense.name: Cross
offense.effect:
Successful gambit: Set up scoring at 0, 1, or 3 (with speed bonus). 
Failed gambit: opponent auto wins a contest to get the deflected ball.

defense.name: Deflect
defense.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If reaches the goal zone, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1.

defense.name: Clear
defense.effect:
Successful gambit: ball moves back 3. If reaches the goal zone may set up scoring. Ball speed -3. 
Failed gambit: exhaust 2.

defense.name: Steal
defense.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Manipulate ball speed after turnover (up to dSkill).

defense.name: Intercept
defense.effect:
Successful gambit: turnover. Defender and ball move forward 1. Adjust ball speed after turnover (up to dSkill). 
Failed gambit: High Pass reception is uncontested.

defense.name: Pressure
defense.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches the goal zone, risk own goal.

defense.name: Double Team
defense.effect:
Successful gambit: player and ball go back 1; Defender moves 1 forward and nearest teammate behind joins, gaining Merging for the next defensive maneuver. If reaches the goal zone, own goal risk.
Failed gambit: Defender and nearest teammate behind go 1 forward.
